params_note: PatchTST and DLinear both concatenate the future control path as input channels (exo_mode=future_as_channels). DLinear is channel-independent with shared weights, so its parameter count does not depend on the number of channels: with L=20 and H=100 it is 4,200, whereas the appendix prints 7,320 (the value obtained for the 60-step datasets).
